what_they_do.text: Persistent Systems Limited is a technology services company focused on software and product engineering at the intersection of AI, data, and modernization. The company builds, modernizes, and manages resilient, business-critical technology systems for enterprises transitioning from automation to intelligence. Its offerings are platform-driven and supported by proprietary AI platforms including SASVA, iAURA, and GenAI Hub.

customers_and_markets.text: End markets span Software & High-Tech, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), and Healthcare and Lifesciences.
Geographic revenue mix in Q2 FY27 in USD terms recorded YoY growth of 22.5% in North America, 19.4% in India, and 67% in Rest of World, while Europe declined 8.5% due to client-specific events.

Client tiers in Q2 FY27 include 4 customers with annual revenue greater than USD 50 million, 13 in the USD 20 million plus bracket, 34 in the USD 10 million plus bracket, 60 in the USD 5 million plus category, and 280 in the USD 1 million plus category.

recent_developments.text: Persistent signed an agreement to acquire European digital engineering firm Nagarro to form an enterprise with over $2.9 billion in revenue run rate and 46,000+ professionals across 40 countries.

The company secured 94.04% of Nagarro's share capital in its public takeover offer by October 2026 and approved raising USD 1.25 billion in long-term debt and equity financing (including USD 450 million via QIP or equity-linked instruments).
Persistent introduced its Software Reinvention offering in Q2 FY27 to assist enterprise software clients in building AI-native products and modernizing legacy suites.

bull.text: Persistent delivered its 26th consecutive quarter of revenue growth in Q2 FY27, rising 20% YoY to $487.6 million (Rs 46,639 million, up 30.3% YoY), extending a 3-year revenue CAGR of 20.9% backed by its $650 million+ 6.5-year Software Reinvention deal.

Record collections lowered billed DSO from 61 to 50 days and lifted TTM OCF-to-PAT to 96.6% in Q2 FY27 (in line with a 3-year CFO/PAT ratio of 0.97x), alongside Rs 29,996.7 million in cash and low pre-deal debt/equity of 0.06x.

Having secured 94.04% of Nagarro's share capital in the open offer, the combination will form a $2.9 billion+ revenue entity that lifts Persistent's European revenue share from roughly 8%-8.5% to 22% with an overlap of only 10 clients across ~200 $1 million+ accounts each.

bear.text: Although management stated in June 2026 that its $650 million+ large deal would be margin accretive from Q2 onwards, Q2 FY27 EBIT margin fell 130 bps YoY to 15% (with EBITDA margin contracting 5 pts YoY to 14%), weighed down by a 90 bps drag from ~$4 million in quarterly amortization on third-party tools and licenses.

Nagarro acquisition expenses of Rs 1,853.4 million drove a 25.4% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 reported PAT to Rs 3,515.1 million (with $25 to 30 million more in costs expected over the next two quarters), while management reversed its earlier no-QIP/no-dilution pledge to plan a $450 million equity or equity-linked raise within a $1.25 billion financing package for the €1.27 billion deal.

Order momentum softened sequentially in Q2 FY27 with TCV bookings at $633.5 million (vs $1,146.2 million in Q1) as macro decision-making slowed and deals slipped, while Europe revenue declined 8.5% YoY due to client-specific ramp-downs.

watch.text: Receipt of RBI and Austrian and Spanish FDI approvals to close the Nagarro acquisition by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27, alongside the terms of the $1.25 billion debt-and-equity financing and pacing of the remaining $25 to 30 million in transaction expenses.

Recovery in EBIT margin from Q2's 15% toward management's 16%-17% aspirational range as wage-hike headwinds pass and FinOps/AI optimization begins offsetting the ~$4 million quarterly amortization on the large deal.
Closure of slipped deals in Q3 bookings following Q2's softer $633.5 million TCV, as well as a growth rebound in Healthcare and Lifesciences (12% YoY) and stabilization in Europe (-8.5% YoY).

about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration [1] . It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS [2] .
